# App Creators skills

> Open-source agent skills for creators who built an app with AI and now need to publish it. Pre-release: six skills ship, app-creators, publish-readiness, store-listing, publish-ios, publish-android, and publish-web, and none is verified on a real account. publish-readiness checks App Store, Google Play, and web readiness, and store-listing writes App Store and Google Play listing copy and a screenshot plan; both touch no store. publish-ios takes an Expo, Flutter, or Xcode app to App Store review and release, and publish-android takes an Expo, Flutter, or Kotlin app to Google Play review and release. User acquisition and monetization skills are planned and have not shipped.

Claude Code install: `claude plugin marketplace add interskh/app-creators-skills`, then `claude plugin install app-creators@app-creators`. Codex install: `npx skills add interskh/app-creators-skills -a codex`. Other skills.sh agents: `npx skills add interskh/app-creators-skills`. Install all six skills, because publish-readiness, store-listing, publish-ios, publish-android, and publish-web read the state file that app-creators writes.

## Skills

- [app-creators](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/app-creators/SKILL.md): Detects the project's framework and destinations, writes .app-creators/state.md, and names the next skill. Triggers: start, where do I begin, set up app creators, what's next, ship my app.
- [app-creators, Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/app-creators/SKILL.zh.md): Chinese version of app-creators. Triggers: 开始, 从哪开始, 下一步, 发布我的应用.
- [publish-readiness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-readiness/SKILL.md): Checks whether an app is ready for the App Store, Google Play, or the web, and writes .app-creators/readiness.md with a fix for every gap. Touches no store or account. Triggers: is my app ready, readiness check, pre-flight, before I submit, privacy policy, age rating, data inventory.
- [publish-readiness, Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-readiness/SKILL.zh.md): Chinese version of publish-readiness. Triggers: 发布前检查, 能发布了吗, 就绪检查, 上架前检查, 隐私政策, 年龄分级.
- [store-listing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/store-listing/SKILL.md): Writes App Store and Google Play listing copy in English and Chinese from what the code shows, plans the screenshots, checks them against a dated limits table, and writes .app-creators/listing.md. Touches no store or account. Triggers: store listing, listing copy, app description, keywords, screenshot plan, screenshot sizes, character limits.
- [store-listing, Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/store-listing/SKILL.zh.md): Chinese version of store-listing. Triggers: 商店文案, 上架文案, 应用描述, 关键词, 截图规划, 字数限制.
- [publish-ios](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-ios/SKILL.md): Takes an Expo, Flutter, or Xcode app to App Store review and release: Apple Developer Program, app record, signing, build and upload with EAS, flutter build ipa, or an Xcode archive, TestFlight, App Privacy and age rating from the readiness report. Stops at every human step, and asks for a yes before anything reaches a reviewer or the public. Triggers: publish to the App Store, ship to iOS, TestFlight, submit for review, App Store Connect.
- [publish-ios, Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-ios/SKILL.zh.md): Chinese version of publish-ios. Triggers: 发布到 App Store, 上架 iOS, 上架苹果, 提交审核, 苹果开发者账号.
- [publish-android](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/SKILL.md): Takes an Expo, Flutter, or Kotlin app to Google Play review and release: Play Console developer account, app record, Play App Signing, an Android App Bundle built with EAS, flutter build appbundle, or Gradle, the target API level check, testing tracks, Data safety and content rating from the readiness report. Stops at every human step, and asks for a yes before anything reaches a reviewer, a tester, or the public. Triggers: publish to Google Play, ship to Android, Play Console, internal testing, closed testing, submit for review.
- [publish-android, Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/SKILL.zh.md): Chinese version of publish-android. Triggers: 发布到 Google Play, 上架安卓, 上架谷歌商店, 提交审核, Google Play 开发者账号.
- [publish-web](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-web/SKILL.md): Deploys a Next.js, Vite, or static web app to Vercel, or a Vite, static, or Next.js static-export app to Cloudflare Pages, with a custom domain and PWA install support. Triggers: publish, deploy, go live, put it online, PWA, custom domain.
- [publish-web, Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-web/SKILL.zh.md): Chinese version of publish-web. Triggers: 发布网站, 部署, 上线, 网页版.

## Docs

- [README and install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/README.md): Install commands per agent and one paragraph per skill.
- [State file schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/docs/STATE.md): The .app-creators/state.md fields every skill reads and writes.
- [Skill conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/docs/SKILL-CONVENTIONS.md): The SKILL.md contract, section order, and verification ladder.

## Optional

- [Readiness checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-readiness/references/checks.md): What check-readiness.py decides, the rule behind each check, and each fix.
- [Data inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-readiness/references/data-inventory.md): What counts as collected on each store, and how each data type maps to App Privacy and Data safety.
- [Age rating](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-readiness/references/age-rating.md): The App Store and Google Play age rating questions and their ids.
- [Smoke run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-readiness/references/smoke-run.md): Toolchain checks and release-run commands per framework.
- [Readiness verified runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-readiness/references/verified-runs.md): Per-route verification record for publish-readiness.
- [Store listing limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/store-listing/references/limits.md): Field limits and screenshot sizes per store, each with its source and check date, and the rules check-listing.py does not check.
- [Listing verified runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/store-listing/references/verified-runs.md): Per-route verification record for store-listing.
- [iOS Expo route](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-ios/references/expo.md): Commands, release identity, build revision, and forbidden flags for the Expo route of publish-ios.
- [iOS Flutter route](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-ios/references/flutter.md): Commands, release identity, build revision, and forbidden flags for the Flutter route of publish-ios.
- [iOS Xcode route](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-ios/references/xcode.md): Commands, release identity, build revision, and forbidden flags for the Xcode route of publish-ios.
- [App Store statuses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-ios/references/statuses.md): Apple status names, what each one proves, and how each maps to the state file.
- [App Store release](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-ios/references/release.md): Submitting, release options, and phased release, with the settings that would skip a yes.
- [iOS verified runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-ios/references/verified-runs.md): Per-route verification record for publish-ios.
- [Android Expo route](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/references/expo.md): Commands, release identity, build revision, and forbidden settings for the Expo route of publish-android.
- [Android Flutter route](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/references/flutter.md): Commands, release identity, upload key, build revision, and forbidden settings for the Flutter route of publish-android.
- [Android Kotlin route](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/references/gradle.md): Commands, release identity, upload key, build revision, and forbidden settings for the Gradle (Kotlin) route of publish-android.
- [Target API level check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/references/target-api.md): Google Play's target API level requirement and how to read it from a built bundle.
- [Google Play statuses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/references/statuses.md): Play Console status names, what each one proves, and how each maps to the state file.
- [Google Play release](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/references/release.md): Sending for review, managed publishing, publishing, and staged rollout, with the settings that would skip a yes.
- [Android verified runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-android/references/verified-runs.md): Per-route verification record for publish-android.
- [Vercel reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-web/references/vercel.md): Vercel detail for publish-web.
- [Cloudflare Pages reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-web/references/cloudflare-pages.md): Cloudflare Pages detail for publish-web.
- [PWA checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/skills/publish-web/references/pwa-checklist.md): What a web app needs to be installable.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interskh/app-creators-skills/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Planned skills and their status.
